checks.title: Goal Owner
checks.instructions: Agree on the customer outcome and source, decision and action owners. Produce an exact-requirement release readiness decision with named blockers or verified go evidence.

checks.title: Subject Scope
checks.instructions: Bind exact tenant and subject IDs. One accepted requirement, product, build, flag revision and rollout owner; no inferred exposure or adoption.

checks.title: Source Policy
checks.instructions: Agree on data access, version and source-of-truth policy. Read current approved requirement, build and flag, independent QA gate, help content and versioned usage rule.

checks.title: Decision Rule
checks.instructions: Record the blocking decision rule and evidence gaps. A passing QA gate is one input. Product go needs current help, measurement and rollout authority; a no-go names blockers.

checks.title: Team Bindings
checks.instructions: Inspect the named Crew templates and existing compatible Crews. Record exact Crew IDs, skill versions and grants; propose creation only for a missing owner or access boundary.

checks.title: Source Access
checks.instructions: Read at least one real authorized first-stage record and the current downstream source. Record source IDs, observed times, permissions, missing fields and owner.

checks.title: Handoff Contract
checks.instructions: Run scripts/validate_handoff.py on each stage artifact. Block wrong tenant, subject, source revision, producer, approval or route-specific claim. The typed sequence is product-requirements-brief/v1 → product-release-readiness/v1.

checks.title: Plan Review
checks.instructions: Show the concrete Crew bindings, artifact paths, validator steps, manual route, approvals, deduplication, cost and notifications. No flag, deployment, help publication or announcement from installation. A go decision is not customer exposure or feature adoption.

checks.title: Test Run
checks.instructions: Run a real authorized requirement/build pair, re-read current gate and help revision, and have the Product owner review go or no-go. Save real source references, artifacts, validation and owner corrections. Fictional examples cannot complete this check.

checks.title: Activation Choice
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any event or schedule needs exact subject and deduplication keys, permissions, retry limits, cost and notification review. Keep all consequential actions behind separate approval and provider receipts.
